documentTitle: The browser tab's title, not visible in the page. {page} is the current route's own name (already translated) and {app} is the product name, which is a brand and never translated. Only the separator is a decision — its glyph and spacing are typographic, so they belong to the locale rather than to markup. Keep it short; a tab truncates.
login: Tab title of the sign-in screen. A noun in Polish ('Logowanie'), not the button's imperative — this names a page, it does not ask for an action. ≤2 words.
notFound: Tab title of the 404 screen. Same string role as errors.notFound.title, which is the heading INSIDE that page; kept separate because a tab title may need to be shorter than a heading. ≤3 words.
contactDetail: Breadcrumb leaf for one contact's page (parent: Contacts). Noun, SINGULAR — it names one record. 1 word.
pipelineStages: Breadcrumb leaf for the pipeline stage editor (parent: Pipeline). Glossary: stage → etap. Plural.
formsAnalytics: Breadcrumb leaf for form submission statistics (parent: Forms). 1 word.
formBuilder: Breadcrumb leaf for the form field editor (parent: Forms). ≤2 words. It is where you build a form's fields, not where you fill one in.
